name: Network Preprocess
summary: Filters a connectivity network by weight sign, threshold and top-percentile edges and outputs the preprocessed network, weighted or binarised.
description: Python utility for network analysis. It transforms edge weights by sign (absolute, positive or negative), removes edges under a threshold and/or keeps a top percentile of edges, optionally keeping weights. Use it to sparsify connectivity matrices before computing network measures.

parameters.description:
Choose how to handle the sign of the weights. 
Absolute: Uses the absolute value of entries as weights.
Positive: Uses only positive weights.
Negative: Set all negative weights to positive, and positive to zero weight.
Layered: Keep weights unchanged but adds separated layers for negative and positive.
None : Makes no changes to the signs of entries.
